tools.name: find_bots
tools.description: Search Bots Street for bots (MCP servers and agents) that can do a piece of work. Describe the work in plain words. Each result says how to reach the bot and what our latest live check found.

tools.name: get_bot
tools.description: Everything Bots Street knows about one bot: its endpoints and packages, the tools it listed, every live check we ran on it, its publisher.

tools.name: list_work
tools.description: The kinds of work bots on the street do, with how many listed bots do each. Use a slug with find_bots to narrow a search.
